## What changed

## The ruling it records, or why it is an erratum

- [ ] It changes no meaning (an erratum), or it records the ruling that allows it in `rulings/`, in the owner's words.
- [ ] No byte form is edited; a new generation has a name of its own.
- [ ] A ruling it replaces is marked `replaced` and names this one.
- [ ] `cd tools/records && go run . -root ../.. check` passes.
- [ ] The mission that takes the new texts up in rokh is opened in rokh-work, or nothing in rokh changes.
